offering_description.value: Operates online marketplaces where independent sellers list handmade, vintage, craft and resale goods for individual buyers worldwide. It earns fees from sellers and advertising, and provides payments, shipping tools and a platform for transactions.

primary_services.value: online marketplace hosting; payment processing; seller advertising; shipping label services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual shoppers buying crafts, vintage, fashion and home goods; B2B: independent sellers, small craft makers and resale shops listing goods

end_markets.value: consumer retail; fashion and resale; home and living; arts and crafts; musical instruments

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: listing, transaction and payment processing fees paid by sellers; advertising: promoted listings and advertising purchased by sellers; subscription: seller subscription plans offering extra tools and discounts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates marketplace websites and apps connecting sellers and buyers; financial intermediary: processes buyer payments and pays sellers, taking fees on transactions; service provider: offers shipping, advertising and seller tools to small sellers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; financial intermediary; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Marketplaces reach buyers and sellers across many countries, with the largest activity in the United States, Europe and the UK

specialization.value: related lines: Etsy marketplace for crafts and vintage, Depop for fashion resale, Reverb for musical instruments

distribution_channels.value: online: websites and mobile apps where buyers browse and purchase

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, payment, data privacy and online marketplace rules such as EU digital services regulation
